rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a full blastocyst and intact zona, but the image does not clearly support a confidently distinct compact ICM or uniformly cohesive circumferential TE; some described details appear more certain than the image allows.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior live birth and ectopic, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, especially around tubal-factor/ectopic risk and favorable age/embryo factors, though some quantitative modifiers and distinctions between implantation and clinical pregnancy rates are somewhat imprecise.

Largely aligned on single embryo transfer, hydrosalpinx concern, and follow-up, but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin, ERA after one failure in this context, and broad PGT-A suggestion at age 31 are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical next steps including tubal assessment, eSET, luteal support, and early ectopic surveillance; however, a few recommendations are more speculative than standard.
